title: Lesson 12: Message Queues & Asynchronous Processing — js-tools
desc: Acking at the wrong moment loses 352 jobs without a trace — the maximum lost is exactly the prefetch size, which turns prefetch into a reliability parameter; a poison message does not block a Redis Streams queue, it accumulates silently, so the mandatory safeguard is an alert on pending-list length; four times the consumers is only 2.68 times faster because the bottleneck moved to single-threaded Redis; and queue depth is the number one health metric.
